messages.content:
Alian AI is the AI services division of Alian Software, an engineering firm with over 15 years of experience building production enterprise systems for clients in manufacturing, finance, and SaaS. 

We are an engineering team that focuses on building production-ready AI—including chatbots, agents, RAG apps, automation pipelines, and predictive models—that can be shipped in weeks and handed over to your team to run.
